children.name: Title
children.characters:
Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
with Blueberry Compote

children.name: Description
children.characters:
Tall, tender pancakes lifted with whipped ricotta and bright lemon, finished with a
quick maple blueberry compote. Weekend-worthy, weekday-easy.

children.name: Ingredient / melted butter, plus more for the pan
Name
children.characters: melted butter, plus more for the pan

children.name: Text
children.characters: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.

children.name: Text
children.characters: In a second bowl, whisk the ricotta, milk, eggs, lemon zest and lemon juice until smooth.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Fold the wet ingredients into the dry until just combined, then rest the batter.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Simmer the blueberries and maple syrup over medium heat until jammy.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Cook ¼-cup scoops on a buttered griddle until golden, then flip.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Stack the pancakes, spoon over the compote and finish with extra lemon zest.

children.name: Body
children.characters: Drain watery ricotta in a sieve for 10 minutes so the batter stays thick and the pancakes rise tall.
